question: Mozzarella, cheddar and camembert are varieties of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**cheese**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mozzarella** is a delicate, white, extended Italian cheddar produced using the **milk of water bison**.
 
• Cheddar is a firm, smooth cheddar that is yellow in variety, while parmesan is a hard, dry Italian cheddar
